measures.name: Bottom 20% Days to Final Median
measures.expression:
VAR TotalCenters =
   CALCULATE ( COUNTROWS ( Center ), REMOVEFILTERS ( Center ), NOT ISBLANK ( [Overall Ranking] ) )
VAR GroupSize =
   ROUNDUP ( TotalCenters * 0.2, 0 )
VAR BottomCenters =
   TOPN ( GroupSize, ALL ( Center ), [Overall Ranking], DESC )
RETURN
   AVERAGEX ( BottomCenters, [Days to Final Median] )
